description: Verified exam notes for 14 October 2026 covering inflation, banking reform, social protection, science, defence, international relations, skills finance and rural industry.

stories.title: September wholesale inflation rises to 11.39% under the new WPI series
stories.summary: The Office of the Economic Adviser released provisional Wholesale Price Index data for September 2026. Year-on-year WPI inflation rose to 11.39%, compared with 9.92% in August. The release uses the revised 2022–23 base year and identifies mineral oils, food articles, crude petroleum and natural gas, coal and lignite, basic metals, chemicals, textiles, rubber and plastics, and electrical equipment among the main drivers.
key_facts: The all-commodities WPI stood at 112.5 in September 2026, up from 110.8 in August.
Inflation was 8.67% for primary articles, 25.85% for fuel and power, and 9.76% for manufactured products.
The WPI Food Index recorded 8.66% year-on-year inflation, compared with 7.05% in August.
The provisional September index was compiled with a weighted response rate of 83.4%.
stories.exam_link: WPI measures wholesale price movements and is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser under DPIIT; unlike CPI, it does not directly measure retail household inflation.
stories.source_title: PIB — Provisional WPI, Output PPI and Trial Input PPI for September 2026, 14 October 2026

stories.title: CCEA approves Fairfax-backed buyer for 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank
stories.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved M/s 10955230 Canada Inc., whose parent is Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd., as the strategic buyer for IDBI Bank. The approval covers acquisition of a combined 60.72% stake for ₹52,878.0806181 crore. It is an approval for the strategic transaction; completion remains subject to the prescribed closing process and regulatory requirements.
key_facts: The Government of India component being sold is 30.48% and the LIC component is 30.24%.
After the transaction, the Government is to retain 15% and LIC 19% of IDBI Bank's equity.
The buyer was selected through a two-stage competitive bidding process.
IDBI Bank is a scheduled commercial bank regulated by the Reserve Bank of India.
stories.exam_link: Strategic disinvestment involves transfer of a substantial government stake along with management control; DIPAM coordinates central public-asset disinvestment policy.
stories.source_title: PIB — Government Approves Strategic Restructuring of IDBI Bank Ltd., 14 October 2026

stories.title: Cabinet extends and redesigns the National Social Assistance Programme
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved continuation of the National Social Assistance Programme for five years from 2026–27 to 2030–31 with an outlay of ₹53,428 crore. The programme is to be renamed Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana. Disability-pension eligibility and assistance are revised, while the old-age, widow and family-benefit schemes continue in their existing form.
key_facts: The approval is expected to cover 3.20 crore beneficiaries across all 36 States and Union Territories.
The benchmark-disability threshold for the disability pension falls from 80% to 40%.
The minimum age for disability pension is changed to eligibility since birth.
Central assistance for the disability pension is ₹375 a month for ages 0–79 and ₹625 for age 80 and above.
Implementation guidelines for the revised disability provisions are to be issued and implemented within three months.
stories.exam_link: NSAP was launched in 1995 in furtherance of Article 41, a Directive Principle concerning public assistance in cases such as old age, sickness and disablement.
stories.source_title: PIB — Cabinet approves continuation of National Social Assistance Programme, 14 October 2026

stories.title: Cabinet approves 78-day productivity-linked bonus for railway employees
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a Productivity-Linked Bonus equivalent to 78 days' wages for eligible non-gazetted railway employees. The expenditure is estimated at ₹2,009.61 crore and is intended to recognise railway staff performance during 2025–26.
key_facts: The decision covers 11,40,770 railway employees.
The maximum amount payable to an eligible employee is ₹17,951.
Eligible categories include track maintainers, loco pilots, train managers, station masters, supervisors, technicians, helpers, pointsmen and ministerial staff.
Indian Railways reported loading 1,670 million tonnes of cargo and carrying about 7.41 billion passengers in 2025–26.
stories.exam_link: A productivity-linked bonus connects an employee payment with an organisation's performance; it differs from a universal ex-gratia payment.
stories.source_title: PIB — Cabinet approves Productivity Linked Bonus for 78 days to Railway Employees, 14 October 2026

stories.title: TDB signs ₹151-crore RDI agreement for YETI heavy-lift autonomous aircraft
stories.summary: The Technology Development Board signed an agreement with ideaForge Technology Ltd. for ₹151 crore of support under the Research, Development and Innovation Fund. The project aims to develop YETI, an indigenous hybrid vertical-take-off-and-landing fixed-wing autonomous aerial logistics vehicle, and advance it from Technology Readiness Level 4 to TRL 9.
key_facts: The total project cost is stated as ₹302 crore, with TDB support of ₹151 crore.
YETI is designed for payloads of up to 200 kg and a targeted range of up to 200 km.
Its stated operating altitude is up to 6,500 metres above mean sea level.
Potential uses include logistics in high-altitude, remote and disaster-affected areas.
stories.exam_link: Technology Readiness Levels run from early basic principles to a system proven in an operational environment; TRL 9 denotes the highest maturity stage.
stories.source_title: PIB — TDB agreement for YETI heavy-lift autonomous aerial logistics vehicle, 14 October 2026

stories.title: NIPER Raebareli and AstraZeneca partner to expand clinical-trial capacity
stories.summary: NIPER Raebareli and AstraZeneca India signed a partnership to extend clinical-trial capabilities beyond metropolitan centres. The initiative plans workforce training and inspection-ready research sites across 25 emerging geographies, supporting the Government's Biopharma SHAKTI vision. This is a capacity-building partnership, not the announcement of a newly approved medicine.
key_facts: The collaboration covers 25 emerging research geographies across India.
It seeks to build a trained workforce and sites capable of meeting inspection requirements.
Biopharma SHAKTI includes a wider objective of establishing 1,000 clinical-trial sites in India.
NIPERs are national institutes under the Department of Pharmaceuticals.
stories.exam_link: Clinical trials evaluate medical interventions in people through regulated phases; ethical oversight, informed consent and data integrity are core requirements.
stories.source_title: PIB — NIPER Raebareli–AstraZeneca collaboration under Biopharma SHAKTI, 14 October 2026

stories.title: Indian Navy completes its maiden command of Combined Task Force 154
stories.summary: The Indian Navy was scheduled to relinquish command of Combined Task Force 154 at Manama, Bahrain, marking completion of its first command of a Combined Maritime Forces task force. CTF 154 is the partnership's multinational maritime training task force, focused on capacity building, interoperability and operational readiness.
key_facts: The Combined Maritime Forces partnership comprises 47 nations.
India joined CMF as an Associate Partner in 2022 and became a full member in 2023.
The Indian Navy assumed command of CTF 154 on 11 February 2026.
The tenure generated more than 7,800 training hours with personnel from 39 countries.
Activities included 20 Staff Enhancement Training engagements and two multinational readiness operations.
stories.exam_link: Manama is the capital of Bahrain in the Persian Gulf; the Combined Maritime Forces is a multinational maritime-security partnership headquartered there.
stories.source_title: PIB — Indian Navy to hand over command of Combined Task Force 154, 14 October 2026

stories.title: India and Russia hold seventh mechanism on Pakistan and Afghanistan
stories.summary: India and Russia held the seventh round of their Special Mechanism on Pakistan and Afghanistan in New Delhi. The structured consultation was co-chaired by India's Deputy National Security Adviser Pavan Kapoor and Aleksandr Venediktov, Deputy Secretary of Russia's Security Council, for discussion of issues of common interest concerning the two neighbouring countries.
key_facts: The meeting was held in New Delhi on 14 October 2026.
This was the seventh round under the bilateral special mechanism.
The mechanism provides a dedicated India–Russia channel for consultations concerning Pakistan and Afghanistan.
stories.exam_link: Afghanistan links South Asia with Central Asia, while Pakistan borders both India and Afghanistan; developments in the region affect security, connectivity and counter-terrorism policy.
stories.source_title: Ministry of External Affairs — 7th India–Russia Special Mechanism on Pakistan and Afghanistan, 14 October 2026

stories.title: High-Level Committee on Demographic Changes launches public portal
stories.summary: The Chairman of the High-Level Committee on Demographic Changes, Justice Prakash Prabhakar Naolekar (Retired), launched the committee's official portal in New Delhi. The portal is operational for public access, stakeholder submissions and data interaction. Its launch is an information-gathering step; the committee has not yet issued its final recommendations through this announcement.
key_facts: The official portal is demography.mha.gov.in.
Central ministries, States and Union Territories, NGOs and individuals may provide inputs.
The portal is intended to support data collection on demographic changes, their causes and underlying factors.
The committee functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs framework.
stories.exam_link: Population is a Union List subject for census purposes; the Census of India is administered by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
stories.source_title: PIB — HLCDC Chairman launches official portal, 14 October 2026

stories.title: NABARD subscribes ₹4 crore to NSDC's Social Stock Exchange issue
stories.summary: NABARD fully subscribed ₹4 crore to the National Skill Development Corporation's maiden Zero Coupon Zero Principal issue on the NSE Social Stock Exchange. The proceeds are intended to support overseas-employment preparation for rural youth. A ZCZP instrument raises funds for eligible social projects without paying interest or returning principal to subscribers.
key_facts: The issue was listed on the Social Stock Exchange platform of the National Stock Exchange.
NABARD's subscription amount was ₹4 crore.
The instrument is a Zero Coupon Zero Principal security, commonly abbreviated ZCZP.
The stated social objective is to support overseas employment opportunities for rural youth.
stories.exam_link: India's Social Stock Exchange operates within recognised stock exchanges and enables eligible not-for-profit organisations to raise funds through instruments such as ZCZP securities.
stories.source_title: PIB Mumbai — NABARD subscribes to NSDC Social Stock Exchange issue, 14 October 2026

stories.title: Official review highlights export and employment growth in India's coir sector
stories.summary: The Ministry of MSME released an official overview of India's coir sector, which converts coconut husk fibre into products such as mats, geotextiles and growing media. It reported strong export growth, widespread rural employment and a large share of women workers. The figures describe sector performance rather than a newly launched scheme.
key_facts: More than 21,000 coir units are registered on the Udyam portal.
The sector provides direct and indirect employment to over 7 lakh workers, about 80% of whom are women from rural households.
Coir and coir-product exports were valued at ₹6,614.40 crore in 2025–26.
Export value increased by 305.70% from ₹1,630.33 crore in 2014–15.
The United States, China, the Netherlands, Spain and the United Kingdom were listed as major export destinations.
stories.exam_link: The Coir Board is a statutory body under the Coir Industry Act, 1953 and functions under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.
stories.source_title: PIB — India's Coir Sector: Creating Livelihoods and Driving Sustainable Growth, 14 October 2026
